GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2020-02-07T16:34:17Z

Title: [QUESTION] What's the equivalent for db.GetCollection<Command>("commands").Include(new string[] { "$.Package", "$.Command", "$.Command.Package" }) in version 5?
Description: Hi there!

I have migrated LiteDB from version 4 to 5 and face the problem that `Include()` doesnt' accept a string **ARRAY** argument anymore.

So far, I have used
`db.GetCollection<Command>("commands").Include(new string[] { "$.Package", "$.Command", "$.Command.Package" })`

`Command` is an abstract class and there are different implementations of it. I save all of them in one collection. Some of them have DBRefs to other objects, some of them have not. That's the reason why I cannot use

`db.GetCollection<Command>("commands").Include(t => t.Package)`

because the abstract class `Command` does not have a `Package` property.

What's the correct way in version 5 to include the DbRefs (and even nested DBRefs) in this scenario with abstract classes?

Looking forward to your answer. Thank you!
